name: Mutual Server Members
description: Compare two of your servers and see which members are in both. Right-click a server's icon, or use /mutual-servers. It only uses the members Discord already has in memory, so open the member list of both servers first.

credits.name: Vendicated and contributors (Vencord), plugin MutualServerMembers by Neversleeper (under her earlier name nnenaza), as found in TestCord

network.why: show the pictures of the members found in both servers
